AboutMe.paragraph1: I am a doctoral candidate at the Institute of Political and Security Studies, University of Szczecin, and a psychology student. For years I have focused on separatism, international security and the situation in the Western Balkans — the main area of my research, which I develop in my doctoral work. In parallel, I am expanding into criminology, victimology and the psychology of security, and training in integrative-psychodynamic psychotherapy, including EMDR for trauma work.
AboutMe.paragraph2: I bring together different fields of knowledge and experience to better understand people — their decisions, behaviour and the contexts in which they act.

PsychoterapiaPage.metaDescription: Information about my psychotherapy training, approach and future practice.
PsychoterapiaPage.intro: For me, psychotherapy is a space where theory meets the person — their history, relationships and capacity for change.
PsychoterapiaPage.warningText: I am currently in psychotherapy training — I do not yet run a practice or see clients. This page is for informational purposes only. If you are in crisis or your life or health is at risk, call the emergency number 112 or contact a crisis helpline for adults in emotional distress: 116 123.

szkolenie.heading: Four years, one goal
szkolenie.p1: Since September 2026 I have been enrolled in a four-year psychotherapy programme accredited by the Scientific Section of Psychotherapy and Family Therapy of the Polish Psychiatric Association.
szkolenie.p2: The training comprises over 1,080 teaching hours — lectures, workshops, supervision and personal therapeutic experience. Sessions are held on weekends.

podejscie.heading: Integrative-psychodynamic orientation
podejscie.p1: I work within the integrative-psychodynamic orientation, which combines classical psychoanalytic foundations with contemporary clinical approaches. The programme includes:
list: Object relations theory and attachment theory
podejscie.emdrLine: The EMDR method (Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing) for trauma work — recommended by the WHO
podejscie.p2: My clinical interests focus particularly on trauma, victimization, anxiety disorders and neurodiversity.

dlaKogo.heading: Eventually: adults
dlaKogo.p1: I plan to work with adults, particularly around trauma (including secondary trauma and victimization), anxiety disorders, relationship difficulties, and the search for meaning and identity. My research background in criminology and victimology provides additional context for understanding clients' specific experiences.

wyksztalcenie.heading: An interdisciplinary context
wyksztalcenie.p1: I combine a background in law and political science (a doctorate at the University of Szczecin) with ongoing training in psychology (integrated studies). This combination lets me view people within a broad context — systemic, legal and interpersonal.
wyksztalcenie.p2: My psychotherapy training adds clinical competence and a practical skill set for working with another person.
